name: supplier-replacement
title: Damaged pallet, replacement needed before Friday
description: A wholesale bakery took delivery of a pallet of insulated shipping boxes that arrived crushed. They need a replacement before Friday and cannot spend more than $500. The original supplier cannot help; the chain of calls has to find someone who can. Every phone number here is in the +1-555 range reserved for fiction, and no call is placed: this scenario drives the mock transport.

outcome.goal: Get a replacement pallet of 500 insulated shipping boxes for the crushed delivery on order BK-7741.

constraints.description: Total replacement cost at or under USD 500
Delivered on or before Friday 11 September
A reference number for the replacement

blockers: Rang out to voicemail; no option to hold.

facts: Order BK-7741 is confirmed damaged in their system.
The insulated box line is out of stock until the end of the month.
They will credit the original order but cannot supply a replacement.
blockers: No stock of insulated shipping boxes until 30 September.

referrals.role: Regional distributor carrying the same line
referrals.reason: Halden say Northgate hold stock of the identical box.

facts: They hold 500 of the identical insulated box in Bay 4.
Next-day courier is the only delivery option at this notice.
The courier surcharge is what pushes the total over the line.

referrals.role: Northgate's own depot, 20km from the bakery
referrals.reason: Same stock without the courier surcharge if collected or locally delivered.

facts: The depot has the same 500 boxes on the floor.
Their own van runs the bakery's district on Thursday mornings.
No courier surcharge on a local run.

offer.summary: 500 insulated shipping boxes, local van delivery

facts: Replacement booked onto Thursday's van run.
Invoice will reference the damaged order BK-7741.

offer.summary: 500 insulated shipping boxes, local van delivery
